summary: Ventura County lookout built about 1930 on Santa Paula Peak, staffed in 1932 during the Matilija Fire, probably lost in the 1948 Wheeler fire; some metal remains on the summit.

facts.design: 4AR-type cab, 14 by 14, with a steeply pitched roof (per a reader comment on Carey's post)
facts.status_note: Fire Lookout index lists the tower as gone; a 2019 trip report found a register box and some metal from the lookout on the summit

access.note: Route to the summit crosses private land behind locked gates; the 2019 writer says not to attempt it without permission. Timber Canyon access is blocked to the public; the East Fork trail is overgrown and washed out.

events.note: Carey, citing Brown, gives 1930 and notes some sources say 1931; a September 1929 report describes work on the new lookout station underway
C.A. Kennison was the fire lookout in September 1932
Matilija Fire, September 1932; Carey says the lookout was surrounded by flames but saved by a backfire
Suspected loss in the 1948 Wheeler Springs fire; Carey and a 2019 trip report both suspect it, and neither confirms it

notes_for_editor: Brief status gone is confirmed by the index. Build year conflicts: work under way in September 1929 (Lompoc Review), 1930 (Carey citing Brown), 1931 (some sources). Design rests on an unnamed reader comment on Carey's post, not on a primary record. Fate is unconfirmed: Carey and a 2019 blog both point to the 1948 Wheeler fire without confirming it. Access set to permission because the route crosses private gated land; the story gives no directions. Staffing covers only 1932 (Kennison). No corrections proposed.
